_what_this_is: THE RESOLVER-WIDER CEILING for pnpm check:access-parity. Each number is how many active tokens the RESOLVER (iam.has_access_for_base) admits on that lane while the generated read policy does not — a door that opens on a row the person's own screen never showed them. Measured live on 2026-09-22.
_the_rule: These numbers may only FALL, and they fall in the same commit that closes the tokens. A rise is a FAILURE. Raising a number here to clear a red is not a repair and is not one of the options.
_not_covered_here: The DANGEROUS direction — policy wider than resolver, a screen that shows what no door will open — has NO baseline and NO ratchet. It fails on the first token, every run. As of 2026-09-22 that is 438 tokens: 418 on the blanket platform-admin lane, 132 on the super-admin system-org arm, 35 on the plain organization-member lane.
